summary: Georgia's tower list places a Macon Lookout Tower in Macon County at elevation 433 (read as feet, about 132 m; the list gives no unit); no source describes its build, staffing, status or site today.

evidence.supports: List entry for the Macon Lookout Tower: coordinates, county and elevation
The page says towers numbered 1 to 72 are listed by the USGS name database
The list's map was last revised in March 2016
The agency's history places its first fire observation tower on the Ware Hotel in Waycross, perhaps linked to a 1928 forestry fair
evidence.quote: Perhaps as a direct consequence of a 1928 Forestry Fair held in Waycross, the first fire observation tower was erected on the Ware Hotel in Waycross

sources.title: History of the Georgia Forestry Commission

notes_for_editor: Very thin record: one state list entry (coordinates, elevation 433, no tag) and the GFC history, which is used only for context about the Ware Hotel tower in Waycross, a different place. The brief's elevation_m of 132.0 matches 433 feet. The name 'Macon Lookout Tower' comes from the USGS name database per the page's note (tower 33 is in the 1-72 range), so it is probably an official-database name, not an author's label. A business directory (hubbiz.com) lists a 'Fire Tower' at the Macon County Forestry Unit in Oglethorpe; that listing is unverified and not used, and nothing in the sources ties it to this list entry. Worth checking locally or with the Georgia Forestry Commission's Macon County office. Two web searches found no build, staffing, status or access information. An anyplaceamerica.com listing for this tower returned HTTP 403 and was not used.
